trap.wellRearWall: vertical at y = poolShift + sqrt(ovality) Rp (back plate)
trap.outlet: horizontal, towards the wall (+y), atmospheric at its end face

case.validNote: valid to the end of the run: the water balance closes within 1 % of the flush volume (45 mL) and less than 5 mL leaves over the rim
case.runNote: job 24: the lip case of job 21 (rim lip 15 mm) with the jets on the long sides (jetPhase 90) and tilted 25 degrees down (alpha 25), coarse, 0 to 3.6 s; the model columns are for jetPhase 0, alpha 10

wetRule: wall face wet when alpha.water > 0.5; model cell wet when more than half of its wall faces are wet; same rule at every sample (0.05 s); shares area-weighted with model cell areas

map.frame: cells in the model frame (wall at model +x); case frame turned by frameRot_deg

trap.regionNote: water (m3) in the bowl above the crest without the trapway (cell zone bowlAbove), in the bowl and well below the crest (the rest, including the first quarter of the half bend), and in the trapway from the dip section on, including the outlet bend and bore above the crest (cell zone trap)
trap.balanceNote: Qin = water from both jets, QoutWater/QoutAir = water and air through the outlet face (air negative when the outlet breathes in), Qrim = water out through the open top above the rim (m3/s); V* the same integrated from 0 over every solver step (m3); residual = Vdomain - Vdomain(0) - Vin + VoutWater + Vrim
trap.sectionNote: crest: section y = yCrest at the start of the horizontal bore, flux towards the outlet, depth = water depth in the round bore from the water share of the section; dip: section y = yDip under the back plate, flux on towards the rising leg, airShare = 1 - alphaMean, pRgh = area mean (Pa; p_rgh = p - rho g z with z = 0 at the crest), headLevel = pRgh / (998 g), the piezometric level of the water there (m above the crest); swirlWell: water-weighted mean tangential speed about the well centre in the plane z = -30 mm

seal.note: mean level over the last 0.5 s of the run, from a vertical line through the well (25 mm behind the axis) and one through the rising leg; seal = well level minus the dip (z = -55.0 mm)

model.source: model.js of origin/dev-2.2 at commit a06849a (read-only copy)

modelFit.source: model.js of origin/dev-2.2 at commit a06849a (read-only copy)

angularMomentum.note: L in kg m2/s about the vertical pool axis through (axis x, axis y): Labove / Lbelow = integral of 998 alpha ((x - axis x) uy - (y - axis y) ux) dV in the bowl above / below the crest without the trapway, every 5 solver steps; torque* = (total, pressure, viscous) z-torque of the wall patch on the fluid in N m, positive in the direction of positive L (wall: bowl above the crest; well: below the crest down to the half bend; trap: the trapway; lid: the wall above the rim; lip: the rim lip, where present), every solver step; jets.LdotIn = angular momentum entering through the jet patches (N m), every 0.01 s; dip.LdotOut = water angular momentum leaving through the dip section towards the rising leg (N m), every 0.01 s; balance per 0.05 s: dL = change of Labove + Lbelow, jets, walls (bowl, well, lid and lip, total torque) and dip as integrals over the step; residual = dL - jets - walls + dip (it also holds the angular momentum leaving over the rim and the torque of the air on the water surface)
